requirements.requirement: Deterministic offline build and read-only check
Complete input and output identity safeguards
Exact accepted evidence and honest delivery
Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view

scenarios.title: CHK-01 Repeatable real build
scenarios.requirement: Deterministic offline build and read-only check
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-01 Repeatable real build

- **WHEN** the same frozen complete production inputs are built into two fresh output directories
- **THEN** canonical output bytes match and check exits zero for the record contract while disclosing unresolved facts

scenarios.title: CHK-02 Read-only malformed output check
scenarios.requirement: Deterministic offline build and read-only check
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-02 Read-only malformed output check

- **WHEN** an existing generated projection is changed to a wrong readable value
- **THEN** check exits one with the violated item and leaves input/output bytes and modification times unchanged

scenarios.title: CHK-11 Actual offline denial
scenarios.requirement: Deterministic offline build and read-only check
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-11 Actual offline denial

- **WHEN** build/check and a child-process socket probe run under the bound namespace/seccomp policy
- **THEN** the probe is actually denied while a local-file positive and valid offline projection succeed, with exact launcher/policy identities and no asserted-only network guarantee

scenarios.title: CHK-12 Offline enforcement unavailable
scenarios.requirement: Deterministic offline build and read-only check
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-12 Offline enforcement unavailable

- **WHEN** the required launcher, namespace/seccomp support or denial self-test is unavailable
- **THEN** offline verification exits three with offline_isolation_unavailable and cannot claim a passed no-network check

scenarios.title: CHK-03 Partial or duplicate queue
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-03 Partial or duplicate queue

- **WHEN** a readable frozen work inventory omits or duplicates one item while actual bound INTERSECTION_UNRESOLVED records and raw symmetric differences still supply the complete independent denominator
- **THEN** validation reports a specific contract violation rather than treating the shortened population as complete

scenarios.title: CHK-04 Empty missing or malformed input
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-04 Empty missing or malformed input

- **WHEN** a required input is absent, empty, unreadable or malformed
- **THEN** the command exits three and reports the precise inability to check, never a zero-item pass

scenarios.title: CHK-05 Source or driver drift
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-05 Source or driver drift

- **WHEN** relevant source/rule/schema/driver bytes or Git-object bindings change between initial binding and completion
- **THEN** the actual command exits three and invalidates run integrity; unrelated HEAD movement is recorded at both ends without relabeling or rejecting identical relevant inputs

scenarios.title: CHK-06 Unsafe output destination
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-06 Unsafe output destination

- **WHEN** output exists or overlaps a repository/input/evidence root or traverses a symlink
- **THEN** the command blocks before mutation and preserves valid sources and siblings

scenarios.title: CHK-13 Closed work dispositions
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-13 Closed work dispositions

- **WHEN** the full queue includes not_attempted, review_pending, attempted_unavailable, budget_exhausted, reviewed_unresolved and reviewed_resolved items
- **THEN** every enum value is counted; open first-two states block complete-work exit zero, the four documented terminal states may pass bookkeeping with required reasons/evidence, and unknown values violate the schema without implying factual closure

scenarios.title: CHK-14 Literal authoritative rules
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-14 Literal authoritative rules

- **WHEN** one displayed design predicate differs from the authoritative rules.json row or a decision binds another rule payload
- **THEN** validation rejects the drift while a literally equal rule/table and exact decision binding pass

scenarios.title: CHK-15 Refreshed official inventory
scenarios.requirement: Complete input and output identity safeguards
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-15 Refreshed official inventory

- **WHEN** a revised plan is frozen for review or implementation
- **THEN** current artifact/context/scenario/task/control manifests are regenerated and hash-bound, earlier copies remain historical, and a stale map cannot silently be used as the current inventory

scenarios.title: CHK-07 Contradiction versus missing evidence
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-07 Contradiction versus missing evidence

- **WHEN** a supported claim is mechanically invalid in one fixture and a claimed retained body is missing in another
- **THEN** actual CLI observations distinguish exit one violation from exit three blocked with named reasons and a passing sibling

scenarios.title: CHK-08 Local collection fixture
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-08 Local collection fixture

- **WHEN** a local HTTP fixture exercises redirects, unavailable bodies or size limits
- **THEN** the report identifies it as a harness control and never counts it as a real protocol primary source

scenarios.title: CHK-09 Final independent reconciliation
scenarios.requirement: Exact accepted evidence and honest delivery
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-09 Final independent reconciliation

- **WHEN** frozen production runs and native Grok/Fable 5.1 reviews are collected with Fable requested as `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` at `--effort medium`
- **THEN** each counted item and artifact hash reconciles to the exact candidate, unavailable review stays open and advisory acceptance is not financial proof
scenarios.independent_evidence_obligation: Independent exact candidate/model/artifact reconciliation, not a substitute CLI review.

scenarios.title: CHK-10 Accepted limited package
scenarios.requirement: Exact accepted evidence and honest delivery
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: CHK-10 Accepted limited package

- **WHEN** record tooling is accepted while original bytes, deployments or semantic disputes remain unresolved
- **THEN** delivery and roadmap updates distinguish accepted tooling from unresolved factual obligations and preserve independent accepted kernel sprint deliveries, including Sprint 9 archive 9908d9b56be2d5ed2b58a16fa8d28b23f33733ff
scenarios.independent_evidence_obligation: Human acceptance/delivery scope and remaining factual obligations reconciled to actual evidence.

scenarios.title: EV-01 Original and derived development cases
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-01 Original and derived development cases

- **WHEN** a normalized candidate gains a source-backed child identity
- **THEN** both original and child remain development with their ancestry and exposure reasons

scenarios.title: EV-02 False untouched promotion
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-02 False untouched promotion

- **WHEN** a current development case or its derivative is marked reserved or untouched
- **THEN** validation rejects the promotion even if the name or version ID changed, including every case in the existing twelve-proposal exposure audit

scenarios.title: EV-07 Described publisher and product exposure
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-07 Described publisher and product exposure

- **WHEN** a retained source for one development unit substantively describes another publisher or product
- **THEN** the development manifest records each description with exact source locators and unresolved identity/alias limits, and later overlap checks include it without treating the URL host as legal identity

scenarios.title: EV-08 Spoofed collector role
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-08 Spoofed collector role

- **WHEN** a queue request claims development while its unit/ancestry lacks bound development-manifest membership
- **THEN** the collector rejects it before any network attempt and an actual registered development sibling remains eligible

scenarios.title: EV-03 No selected holdouts
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-03 No selected holdouts

- **WHEN** the current package has not selected new evaluation cases
- **THEN** the manifest records not_selected with zero cases and evaluation evidence is blocked or not run

scenarios.title: EV-04 Missing evaluation freeze
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-04 Missing evaluation freeze

- **WHEN** required kernel/library/rule/translator/evaluator/development bindings are incomplete
- **THEN** readiness remains blocked_missing_freeze and no semantic case acquisition is permitted

scenarios.title: EV-05 Later complete reservation
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-05 Later complete reservation

- **WHEN** a later independent curator records a new case after a complete freeze and exposure audit
- **THEN** reserved status binds the exact freeze, selection time and declared overlap limits without claiming an executed result

scenarios.title: EV-06 Exposure or later adaptation
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: EV-06 Exposure or later adaptation

- **WHEN** builders inspect a reserved case before evaluation or adapt after its first frozen result
- **THEN** early exposure makes it development and later adaptation retains the original result with a separate post-freeze status

scenarios.title: ADJ-01 Full initial disagreement set
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-01 Full initial disagreement set

- **WHEN** the frozen A/B inputs are compared
- **THEN** the actual normalized INTERSECTION_UNRESOLVED records and raw A/B symmetric differences independently derive 29 unit/facet records across 24 units and 32 label instances, which must exactly equal the queue; existing research drafts may supply bound evidence inputs but do not count as accepted decisions

scenarios.title: ADJ-02 Separate agreed-label challenge
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-02 Separate agreed-label challenge

- **WHEN** the Liquity V1 liquidation challenge is queued
- **THEN** liquidation remains present in both raw label sets, the actual mechanisms facet remains INTERSECTION_UNRESOLVED because redemption differs, and the historical challenge wording is retained without inventing another facet disagreement

scenarios.title: ADJ-03 All disputed labels have rules
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-03 All disputed labels have rules

- **WHEN** the 29 records and separate liquidation challenge are expanded to label claims
- **THEN** all 17 distinct disputed labels plus liquidation reference explicit auditable predicates and no protocol-specific exception

scenarios.title: ADJ-04 Dependency or parent inheritance
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-04 Dependency or parent inheritance

- **WHEN** only an underlying product or unscoped parent text exhibits the proposed label
- **THEN** that evidence cannot establish the child direct-service claim and unsupported promotion is rejected

scenarios.title: ADJ-05 Unknown label predicate
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-05 Unknown label predicate

- **WHEN** an evidence decision proposes a label without a declared rule version and predicate
- **THEN** the decision is rejected without inventing a default predicate

scenarios.title: ADJ-12 Uniform interpretation ruling
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-12 Uniform interpretation ruling

- **WHEN** an accepted R-appchain interpretation is selected for a bound rule version
- **THEN** every effective accepted decision for that rule/version references the same reviewed ruling, and a mismatched or missing reference is rejected across all units, including the Lighter/ApeX/edgeX review queue without predetermining their labels; superseded historical decisions retain their earlier ruling without being treated as current heads

scenarios.title: ADJ-13 Ambiguity remains pending
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-13 Ambiguity remains pending

- **WHEN** a packet's proposed support depends on an unresolved rollup/validium interpretation or an unaccepted ruling
- **THEN** the imported decision stays review_pending and cannot produce accepted support merely from conditional author wording

scenarios.title: ADJ-06 Silence and empty agreement
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-06 Silence and empty agreement

- **WHEN** sources omit a mechanism or both annotations are empty
- **THEN** absence is not inferred and the claim remains not_evidenced unless positive scoped evidence supports another disposition

scenarios.title: ADJ-07 Applicable evidence conflict
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-07 Applicable evidence conflict

- **WHEN** two applicable sources conflict and version/time scoping cannot resolve them
- **THEN** both are retained with a conflicting disposition rather than selected by reviewer majority

scenarios.title: ADJ-08 Partial facet resolution
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-08 Partial facet resolution

- **WHEN** one disputed label is supported but another remains conflicting or not evidenced
- **THEN** the facet remains semantically unresolved despite accepted review of the individual records

scenarios.title: ADJ-09 Version-specific Liquity evidence
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-09 Version-specific Liquity evidence

- **WHEN** validated existing or newly captured V1-specific code/docs address liquidation and redemption conditions and receive independent review
- **THEN** separate accepted established-applicability decisions can update the historical-primary view, while source-only readings enter only the source-claims table without changing old A/B answers, relabelling an imported research packet as a collector run, requiring redundant acquisition of valid bytes, or claiming historical/deployment fidelity

scenarios.title: ADJ-10 Superseded decision
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-10 Superseded decision

- **WHEN** new evidence reverses a previously accepted disposition
- **THEN** a new linked record explains the effective facet change while all prior decision and observation bytes remain available

scenarios.title: ADJ-11 Reviewed unresolved closure
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-11 Reviewed unresolved closure

- **WHEN** every queue item has reviewed records but some dispositions remain not_evidenced or conflicting
- **THEN** work accounting is complete while the report and roadmap retain the exact unresolved semantic count

scenarios.title: ADJ-14 Historical applicability projections
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-14 Historical applicability projections

- **WHEN** the same label has separately reviewed source support with established, current_documentation_only and unresolved applicability
- **THEN** only a unique established historical decision can change the historical facet; other readings remain in their exact scoped source-claims records, and coverage counts each applicability/disposition/review-status combination separately

scenarios.title: ADJ-15 Source-only support cannot close historical facets
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-15 Source-only support cannot close historical facets

- **WHEN** every disputed label has accepted current-documentation support but none has established historical applicability
- **THEN** no historical disagreement is counted semantically resolved, original intersection labels stay visibly provisional, and imports remain unaccepted until separate review

scenarios.title: ADJ-16 Conflicting accepted heads
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-16 Conflicting accepted heads

- **WHEN** two non-superseded accepted decisions share a unit/facet/label/rule-version/scope key, even with equal dispositions
- **THEN** the effective result is conflicting with both IDs and no timestamp/order winner; only a reviewed successor explicitly superseding every head resolves it, while a draft successor does not retire an accepted predecessor

scenarios.title: ADJ-17 Invalid supersession graph
scenarios.requirement: Versioned evidence adjudication and effective view
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ADJ-17 Invalid supersession graph

- **WHEN** a supersession reference is missing, cyclic, self-referential or crosses decision scope/key, or an interpretation has conflicting heads
- **THEN** validation rejects the invalid graph or blocks dependent acceptance without removing earlier bytes; a valid same-key acyclic unique-head sibling projects deterministically

scenarios.title: ID-01 Initial identity baseline
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-01 Initial identity baseline

- **WHEN** the preserved normalization is loaded
- **THEN** 75 development candidates, 11 version labels, 64 unresolved versions and zero verified deployments remain the initial measured inventory

scenarios.title: ID-02 Brand is not deployment
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-02 Brand is not deployment

- **WHEN** a brand, ranking, source version label or official URL is offered without a chain/code binding
- **THEN** deployment verification is refused while supported weaker identity fields remain available

scenarios.title: ID-03 Additional supported product split
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-03 Additional supported product split

- **WHEN** a development source explicitly distinguishes further products or versions
- **THEN** new stable child IDs link to the original candidate and row while original counts and bytes remain unchanged

scenarios.title: ID-04 Ambiguous bundle
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-04 Ambiguous bundle

- **WHEN** the inspected source does not establish which child owns a mechanism or historical residue
- **THEN** the bundle and child attribution remain unresolved rather than inheriting the parent content

scenarios.title: ID-05 Supported dependency with cycle
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-05 Supported dependency with cycle

- **WHEN** source evidence supports typed dependency edges including a cycle
- **THEN** all edges and scoped endpoint identities are retained without deleting cycles or transferring facet labels transitively

scenarios.title: ID-06 No dependency evidence
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-06 No dependency evidence

- **WHEN** a candidate assessment finds no adequate dependency evidence
- **THEN** not_evidenced is recorded and the empty edge set is not reported as independence

scenarios.title: ID-07 Source pin only
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-07 Source pin only

- **WHEN** an exact official code revision and file digests are retained without deployment correspondence
- **THEN** code_pinned is reported while deployment remains unresolved or candidate

scenarios.title: ID-08 Verified direct deployment
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-08 Verified direct deployment

- **WHEN** retained environment, address, block/code and reproducible source/build correspondence all agree
- **THEN** only that scoped deployment is verified with its method and evidence recorded

scenarios.title: ID-09 Proxy or code mismatch
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-09 Proxy or code mismatch

- **WHEN** a proxy implementation at the observation block is omitted or actual code differs from the claimed build
- **THEN** verification is blocked for missing evidence or rejected for demonstrated mismatch, with distinct reasons

scenarios.title: ID-10 Deployment does not imply fidelity
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-10 Deployment does not imply fidelity

- **WHEN** a deployment is verified but no implementation-model comparison or refinement exists
- **THEN** fidelity is at most source_inspected and stronger fidelity counts remain zero for this work

scenarios.title: ID-11 Off-chain scope
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: ID-11 Off-chain scope

- **WHEN** positive scope evidence establishes an off-chain-only product with no applicable deployment
- **THEN** not_applicable names its reason and does not count as a verified deployment or erase external obligations

scenarios.title: SRC-01 Complete original pointer inventory
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-01 Complete original pointer inventory

- **WHEN** the frozen proposal and historical corpus are inventoried
- **THEN** all 72 rows, 62 citation occurrences, 45 distinct tokens and two attachment pointers are represented with exact locators and no source edits

scenarios.title: SRC-02 Opaque token remains unresolved
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-02 Opaque token remains unresolved

- **WHEN** a public primary page supports a claim near an opaque token without the original browsing transcript
- **THEN** the new page is recorded as reconstructed support and the original token mapping remains unresolved

scenarios.title: SRC-03 Actual attachment recovery
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-03 Actual attachment recovery

- **WHEN** the original attachment bytes and a verifiable origin record are available
- **THEN** recovered_original binds those bytes and origin without replacing the historical pointer

scenarios.title: SRC-04 Reconstructed file is not original
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-04 Reconstructed file is not original

- **WHEN** a newly generated crosswalk or plausible filename is presented as the absent original attachment
- **THEN** recovered_original is rejected and the reconstruction retains its own identity

scenarios.title: SRC-13 Transcript provenance assumption
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-13 Transcript provenance assumption

- **WHEN** a supplied browsing transcript maps a historical token and its digest and span match
- **THEN** recovery remains conditional on its explicit reviewed origin-trust assumption; unknown provenance leaves the original mapping unresolved and byte checks do not claim authenticity

scenarios.title: SRC-05 Replay retained capture
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-05 Replay retained capture

- **WHEN** an existing research packet or collector record has retained source bytes with matching digests and exact raw or bound derived-text locators
- **THEN** offline checks validate the original capture/extraction binding and precise product/version/time scope without fresh retrieval, preserve actual acquisition times/tools and origin type, and leave its unaccepted interpretation pending review

scenarios.title: SRC-06 Missing retained body
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-06 Missing retained body

- **WHEN** a source record claims retained status but its body cannot be read
- **THEN** the required replay is blocked with the source ID and no factual promotion; a readable empty/non-substantive body falsely marked retained is rejected with exit one and receives zero support

scenarios.title: SRC-07 Present-day page for historical claim
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-07 Present-day page for historical claim

- **WHEN** only retrieval-time documentation exists for a historical corpus claim
- **THEN** unit_applicability is current_documentation_only, the historical-primary claim remains not evidenced and semantically unresolved, and the source-claims table can show separately reviewed scoped support

scenarios.title: SRC-11 Empty and wrapper import normalization
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-11 Empty and wrapper import normalization

- **WHEN** an old packet calls a zero-byte HTTP202 body or redirect-only/access wrapper retained
- **THEN** import preserves raw bytes/status/manifests but creates a new empty_or_non_substantive overlay record with zero support; retained status or any support locator into it is rejected, while a substantive positive-length retained sibling replays

scenarios.title: SRC-12 Retained derived coordinate space
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-12 Retained derived coordinate space

- **WHEN** a derived-text locator has only extractor metadata, missing output bytes, or an empty/out-of-range byte span
- **THEN** missing extraction output blocks replay with missing_extraction_output, invalid readable spans violate the record contract, and only a nonempty in-range span bound to retained output and original body bytes can replay

scenarios.title: SRC-08 Acquisition budget exhaustion
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-08 Acquisition budget exhaustion

- **WHEN** the declared URL, retry, redirect, size or duration limit is exhausted
- **THEN** the attempt records the exact bound and unresolved remainder and exits blocked rather than claiming a complete acquisition; importing a separately validated earlier research packet preserves its own pass limits and cannot assert that extra failed/fallback URLs met this collector budget

scenarios.title: SRC-09 Restricted or unavailable source
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-09 Restricted or unavailable source

- **WHEN** a development primary source cannot be retrieved or retained through authorized public access
- **THEN** the reason and affected items are recorded without invented bytes or a bypass

scenarios.title: SRC-10 Holdout source request
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-10 Holdout source request

- **WHEN** a collection queue contains a reserved or otherwise non-development case
- **THEN** the collector checks exact membership/ancestry against the bound development manifest and rejects the queue before any request, even if its caller-supplied role says development

scenarios.title: SRC-14 Distinct target and retry accounting
scenarios.normative_block:
#### Scenario: SRC-14 Distinct target and retry accounting

- **WHEN** three requested URL targets include a failed guess, a corrected slug and a third source, with retries and server redirects
- **THEN** all three targets consume slots, same-target retries are bounded to two total attempts, redirects consume their separate five-hop bound, and a fourth requested target blocks before network access while preserving every attempt and pass identity

tasks.text: Freeze proposal/design/five specs/tasks/dispute inventory/scenario map/wiki note and exact context manifest, regenerate authoritative rule/scenario/task/control/artifact inventories and preserve prior snapshots at each official freeze; verify strict OpenSpec validation, 65 unique mapped scenarios and no missing normative rule or task verification.

Obtain separate nonauthor stock GPT-6 and native Fable 5.1 planning verdicts (request `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` with `--effort medium`) on the same frozen candidate; verify exact requested/reported model identities and bundle hashes before implementation, preserving unavailable review as pending.

Add the overlay schema/baseline inputs and real subprocess control harness before behavior implementation; verify the schema validates itself, the original normalization check passes, all preserved inputs retain their hashes, and first behavior controls fail for the intended missing behavior rather than an unrelated fixture error.

Implement lossless proposal occurrence/source-row indexing in `scripts/corpus_adjudication/provenance.py` and `inputs/references.json`; verify exact 72 rows, 62 citation occurrences, 45 token groups and two attachment pointers, including duplicate-token occurrences with distinct source spans.

Implement original-recovery/reconstructed-support statuses and origin requirements; verify transcript-origin trust/custody assumptions stay explicit and unknown origin remains unresolved; actual CLI controls accept a bound original-byte fixture and reject a rebuilt CSV or guessed URL labelled recovered, while a valid replacement retains the unresolved original pointer.

Implement capture records, validated research-packet import, exact raw/derived byte-locator binding and retained/empty_or_non_substantive/fingerprint-only/unavailable/restricted distinctions; verify valid existing bytes replay without network, changed or missing bytes fail with the proper classification, empty/wrapper bodies are normalized only in new overlay records, retained requires positive substantive bytes, derived output bytes/digests are mandatory, nonempty in-range locator spans are checked and empty transport bodies receive no support, historical capture/tool identities survive import, and import validation cannot masquerade as a production collector run.

After task 6.1 establishes the bound development manifest, implement explicit bounded `collect` and account for the complete development work queue using validated existing inputs and recorded acquisition passes for remaining gaps; verify exact three requested-target slots including failed guesses, two total attempts per target, five server redirects outside target slots and 30-second attempt deadlines through a local HTTP fixture; reject role spoofing by actual manifest membership, preserve all attempts and remaining items, distinguish earlier research body limits from future collector URL limits, and reject retrospective collector-budget claims while permitting a valid imported sibling.

Implement identity records and review all 75 original candidates against acquired development evidence; verify exact original membership, separate organization/product/version/source/deployment fields, no brand-derived deployment and a complete resolved/conflicting/unresolved ledger.

Implement additional split ancestry and source-scoped ambiguity/residue records; verify every source-named bundle has an explicit supported split or unresolved decision, all original row/ID/residue bytes survive, and a parent-mechanism inheritance control fails beside a justified child record.

Implement typed dependency assessments in `inputs/dependencies.json` for every candidate; verify evidence/endpoints/version/time bindings, retained cycles, explicit not-evidenced assessments and no transitive facet inheritance using rejecting and valid siblings.

Implement immutable repository/code/configuration pins and source status projection; verify real acquired source bytes match the declared revisions while a source-only pin leaves deployment unverified.

Implement deployment candidate/verified/conflicting records and offline checks for environment, block, direct/proxy code and reproducible build correspondence; verify direct and proxy fixture positives, missing implementation evidence blocked, code/build mismatch violated, and actual production promotion only where the complete required evidence exists.

Implement independent fidelity statuses and evidenced not-applicable deployment scope; verify zero unsupported bounded-differential/refinement promotions, separate counts for code pins and deployments, and explicit off-chain obligations instead of an automatic verified classification.

Independently derive the INTERSECTION_UNRESOLVED set and raw A/B symmetric differences from bound normalized corpus bytes, then compare and import the complete 29-record disagreement inventory (32 disputed label instances) and separate Liquity liquidation challenge into the overlay queue without changing raw observations; verify exact unit/facet/label set equality, 24 affected units, liquidation membership in both raw sets, and the actual INTERSECTION_UNRESOLVED mechanisms facet caused by the redemption difference at generated/corpus.json#/adjudications/77.

Encode `evidence-adjudication/1` with authoritative rules.json, all 18 literally matched design predicates, common scope/direct-service/no-inheritance rules and version-bound interpretation records selected uniformly across units; verify every disputed label has its declared predicate and every accepted affected-rule decision uses the same reviewed interpretation head; ambiguous conditional packets remain review_pending and actual CLI controls reject unknown predicates, dependency-only evidence and unscoped parent inheritance beside valid scoped decisions.

Implement append-only dispositions/review states/supersession and explicit historical-primary/scoped-source projections with mandatory unit_applicability in `scripts/corpus_adjudication/adjudication.py`; verify silence is not refutation, conflicting evidence stays visible, partially resolved facets stay unresolved, only established accepted decisions affect historical facets, current-only support never closes them, same-key supersession is acyclic and unique accepted heads project deterministically, multiple heads conflict and old bytes remain exact.

Validate the existing version-specific Liquity V1 retained primary packets and prepare separate liquidation/redemption decisions, acquiring fresh evidence only for a required gap; verify exact original capture/doc/code/derived locators and tools, source/version/time scope, independent native review findings and no invented collector runs, historical/deployment fidelity or edits to old A/B answers.
